title: Lagged Fed overnight reverse-repo drawdown liquidity support for BTC long or cash
thesis: A complete-week ON RRP endpoint strictly below its value four complete weeks earlier may identify an all-else-equal private-liquidity support state with better subsequent BTC return and path-risk evidence than other weeks.
mechanism: Use official FRED RRPONTSYD observations, select the last non-missing value inside each complete Monday-through-Sunday UTC week, make it usable only on Wednesday 00:00 UTC, compare it with the endpoint exactly four complete weeks earlier, and evaluate one non-overlapping 168-hour BTC response. The supportive state is strictly lower ON RRP; no threshold, smoothing, alternate lag, direction inversion or combined macro factor is allowed.
economic_rationale: If and only if both Design and Validation establish predictive direction, a later matched-capital policy would hold full BTC during supportive weeks and zero-yield cash otherwise. It must improve fee-adjusted Calmar and underwater duration while explicitly charging lost upside and capital utilization.
